Foxglove | Onsite (San Francisco) + Remote | Full Time | https://foxglove.dev/

Foxglove is the leading data infrastructure & observability platform for robotics & physical AI.

Prior experience in the autonomous vehicle or robotics industry is a bonus, but not required.

Many open roles:

- Design Engineer

- Applied ML Engineer

- ML Platform Engineer

- Product Manager, Data Platform

Email in profile (please do not email me 5 paragraphs of AI text, just one or two human-written sentences on why you are interested + resume or linkedin is sufficient).

https://foxglove.dev/careers
